subject: Request: Full penetration test report under NDA + remediation status
messages:
From: Jared Morris <security@acme-corp.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for full pentest report (NDA) + scope clarifications

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team would like the full penetration test report Redwood commissioned in October and the associated scope, test plan, and remediation tracker. We're happy to sign an NDA — can you send over your standard NDA or let us know the controls you need in place?

Two quick clarifications we need before signing:
- Confirm whether the report includes external and internal network testing, and whether the scope included data-plane checks for S3/backups.
- Do you have a mapping of findings to SOC 2 control criteria or SIG questions? That would speed our review.

Please CC your security and legal folks so we can get this arranged.

Regards,
Jared Morris
Head of Security, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

--
(External)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Morris <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for full pentest report (NDA) + scope clarifications

Hi Jared — thanks for the note and great to meet last week. I'm looping in Marcus (Product Security) and Rishi (Legal) to help with the technical scope and the NDA.

High-level: the engagement covered both external and internal infrastructure vectors; the testers performed authenticated application-layer checks against a staging copy and external perimeter scans. We'll confirm exact targets and provide a scope statement.

Next steps we propose:
1) Sign a mutually acceptable NDA (we can provide our template with the minimum carve-outs)
2) Deliver a redacted executive summary and a version of the full report with narrow redactions for customer-identifying IP and internal ticket IDs
3) Provide a remediation status document with completed/partial/plan-of-record items, and a SOC 2 control mapping for the medium/high findings.

Marcus — can you prepare a redaction matrix and a short remediation status snapshot we can deliver as soon as NDA is in place?
Rishi — please review our NDA template and flag any clauses that will block delivery to platform customers.

Jared — I'll circulate our redlineable NDA within the hour. If it's easier we can DocuSign the final version.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for full pentest report (NDA) + scope clarifications (internal)

Team — attaching the redaction matrix and a quick remediation snapshot for Acme. Topline: two high findings (auth bypass on legacy admin endpoint, exposed S3 snapshot metadata) and three medium findings (rate-limit bypass, token leakage via logs, outdated dependency).

Patch/remediation status (short):
- Auth bypass (HIGH): temporary WAF rule applied 2026-11-25, full fix targeted for 2026-12-10.
- S3 snapshot metadata (HIGH): snapshots rotated and access tightened 2026-11-28; object ACLs fixed, final verification planned 2026-12-02.
- Rate-limit bypass (MED): mitigation in staging; scheduled prod deploy 2026-12-08.
- Token leakage via logs (MED): removed PII from logs 2026-11-29; retention policy change scheduled 2026-12-05.
- Outdated dependency (MED): patching scheduled 2026-12-07.

Attachment: redaction_matrix_ACME_20261130.xlsx (matrix with suggested redaction categories: customer-identifiers, internal ticket IDs, tester tooling signatures).

Marcus Lin
Director, Product Security
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

--
(Internal)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NDA redline suggestions (internal)

Stephanie / Marcus — I reviewed Acme's standard NDA (they pinged us earlier) and did a redline of our template. Key items:
- Retention period: propose 12 months for full report access, with option to renew; customers requested indefinite retention — we should avoid that.
- Recipient carve-out: limit to named security reviewers and in-house counsel; no broad sharing or public disclosure.
- Subprocessor clause: we need the ability to share with our pen-test vendor (RedTeam Labs) under the same confidentiality terms.
- No public disclosure clause: Acme's template allowed press use after 30 days — we should close that.

I've uploaded a DocuSign-ready redline: https://docusign.com/doc/ABC-ACME-NDA-2026-redline

I also flagged one technical ask from Marcus: keep executive summary unredacted where possible (high-level finding descriptions + remediation status) but redact tooling signatures and internal ticket numbers.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Morris <security@acme-corp.com>, Elena Voss <pen-test@redteamlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood: NDA + redacted pen test deliverables (ACME)

Hi Jared — thanks for the patience. Attached is our proposed NDA (DocuSign link in case you'd rather sign online) and two deliverables we can share immediately once NDA is executed: 1) an executive summary (unredacted for findings + remediation status) and 2) a redacted version of the full report with limited redactions as per the attached matrix.

Attachments: ACME_PenTest_ExecSummary_20261130.pdf, ACME_Redacted_PenTest_20261130.pdf, redaction_matrix_ACME_20261130.xlsx

Quick notes:
- Rishi's legal redlines limit retention to 12 months and recipient list to named security reviewers and in-house counsel; we also included a subprocessor clause to permit RedTeam Labs access when needed.
- Marcus' matrix redacts internal ticket IDs, tester tooling signatures, and any customer-internal hostnames that could expose other customers.
- We will provide a remediation tracker (CSV) that shows status as of delivery and will update weekly until all HIGH findings are closed.

If that works for you, please sign the attached NDA and we'll push the redacted files to the shared drive link and notify your security team. If you'd like a short call (20 min) to walk through the exec summary, happy to schedule.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

[Attachment stubs included: ACME_PenTest_ExecSummary_20261130.pdf (PDF, 120 KB); ACME_Redacted_PenTest_20261130.pdf (PDF, 2.2 MB); redaction_matrix_ACME_20261130.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]
From: Jared Morris <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Voss <pen-test@redteamlabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 12:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood: NDA + redacted pen test deliverables (ACME)

Hi Stephanie — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups before we sign:
1) We need confirmation that the exec summary will explicitly map HIGH/CRITICAL findings to SOC 2 CC or AICPA criteria (or provide a SIG mapping). You mentioned a mapping — can that be delivered with the exec summary?
2) For the remediation tracker, can you provide dates for verification steps (e.g., when verification testing will occur)?
3) We expect the NDA recipient list to include up to 3 external consultants (subprocessors) who will help us validate remediation. Will Redwood allow named external consultants under the NDA?

If those are OK, we can sign the NDA and accept the redacted report. Also — curious if Redwood can provide a one-hour walk-through with Marcus and your engineering lead next week.

Thanks,
Jared
Head of Security, Acme Corp
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Morris <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Voss <pen-test@redteamlabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-03 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood: NDA + redacted pen test deliverables (ACME) — delivery plan and verification timeline

Jared — thanks, and yes to all three items with the following specifics: 

1) SOC 2 / SIG mapping: Marcus will attach a short mapping table to the exec summary that ties each HIGH/CRITICAL finding to the relevant SOC 2 CC criteria and SIG/CAIQ references. We'll include the mapping in the same PDF as the exec summary.

2) Verification dates: we will run verification tests as follows — S3 snapshot verification: 2026-12-02 (completed); auth bypass verification: 2026-12-11 (post-fix); rate-limit verification: 2026-12-09. We'll share verification evidence (logs/scan output) in the shared drive for reviewers named in the NDA.

3) External consultants: we will accept up to 3 named external consultants provided you list them in the NDA execution step; RedTeam Labs is covered under our subprocessor clause. We will ask for consultant names and enforce the same confidentiality obligations.

Delivery plan: once the NDA is signed (DocuSign link), we will: 
- Upload the redacted PDF and exec summary to the shared drive and grant access to named reviewers (within 24 hours)
- Post the remediation tracker CSV and weekly verification snapshots to the same folder
- Schedule a 1-hr walkthrough with Marcus + our engineering lead (please propose 3 times next week)

Final note: attached is the final redacted PDF we will upload after NDA acceptance (ACME_Redacted_PenTest_20261130.pdf). Let us know the consultant names and the preferred time for the walkthrough.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

[Attachment stub: ACME_Redacted_PenTest_20261130.pdf (PDF, 2.2 MB)]
